name: Invisible War Revised
storyline: Remake of Deus Ex: Invisible War done in the original Deus Ex engine - featuring a more grounded approach to the plot of the original. Alex Denton works as a waiter and fixer for his boss at a restaurant in New Orleans years after the events of the original game. Soon he finds himself at the center of a conspiracy and a power play between multiple factions revolving around Alex's very own biology. Only two levels are playable - New Orleans, and Seattle.
summary: Invisible War Revised is an unofficial mod for Deus Ex, a re-imaging of Deus Ex Invisible war. Being incomplete, the current version contains two missions, New Orleans and Seattle.
